note: The declared delta between the suite title map as pinned at AT1 and the map at the end of milestone M3. AT2 reads identity THROUGH this file: every difference the compare reports is listed here with the row that caused it, so a difference that is not listed is a regression rather than a restructure. M3 renames no collected test FILE (git status reports no add, delete or rename anywhere under test/), so the rename set stays empty and the compare needs no --rename-map argument; every difference below is a describe or it TITLE that names a source path M3 moved.

compare_totals.how_counted: node bin/suite-title-map.js --compare bin/pins/at1-suite-titles.json reports one line per (script, file, title) difference. The 23 belonging to M2 are the four files m2-title-delta.json already declares (db_prototype_install.test.js, db_table_parameterized_identifiers.test.js, price_batch_query.test.js, reorg_history_query.test.js); M1's single title rename is already inside this pin, which is why its sha256 equals m2-title-delta.json's pin_before_sha256 and M1 contributes nothing here.

no_test_was_lost: Every dropped title has a same-file added title carrying identical assertion text, at equal counts per file (1/1, 2/2, 2/2, 4/4). There is no file_added and no file_dropped anywhere in the M3 set: not one suite entered or left a script's collection. Each pair differs only in the source PATH the title quotes, and in every case the assertion body is byte-unchanged apart from the path it reads.
